candidates.title: Revisiting Disaggregated Large Language Model Serving for Performance and Energy Implications
candidates.reason: Systematic performance/energy evaluation of prefill-decode disaggregation across KV-transfer media and frequency-scaling strategies; useful for identifying when disaggregation is actually beneficial and for validating serving-system design assumptions.
